Esri World Imagery (export captured 22 October 2026) shows the point on a flat-roofed building with rooftop plant on the north side of the Dutra highway, next to large logistics sheds (visual plausibility only; that this building is RJ01 rather than a neighbour is not independently established). The point is the operator-selected address place on a numbered highway frontage, not a named facility feature; no official address point or parcel was used.
locator.precision: Operator-linked Google Maps address place for Rodovia Presidente Dutra, 4648, Jardim Jose Bonifacio, Sao Joao de Meriti (feature 0x9964e540dbaf29:0x31ce9a9224bd81f; !3d/!4d place coordinates), used as the campus marker for ODATA's RJ01 data centre. It locates the facility address, not a building footprint, plot boundary or entrance.
locator.uncertainty_reason: Google's address place on a numbered federal-highway frontage publishes no positional accuracy and may be interpolated; no official address point or parcel boundary for the RJ01 property was used.

status.summary: ODATA's Brazil locations page, in its version of 25 September 2026 (dateModified 2026-09-25T12:21:12Z), presents its Brazilian hyperscale campuses, lists Data Center RJ01 at Rodovia Presidente Dutra, 4.648, Jardim Jose Bonifacio, Sao Joao de Meriti (RJ) with Tier III design and 'Disponibilidade 24x7x365 / Acesso e operacao continua', and says its data centres have on-site staff 24x7x365 and continuous monitoring supporting the continuity of critical operations, with ODATA's Brazilian operations on 100% renewable energy. The operator's archived RJ01 facility page (Internet Archive copy of 16 September 2026, version of 19 May 2026) gives 19,000 m2 built and 23.4 MW of IT power, carrier neutral, 30 km from Rio de Janeiro. This records the existing RJ01 data centre as operating on 25 September 2026, the modification day of the captured version, not an inspection or opening date. Capacity in service, occupancy and any expansion are not established.

additions.successor_review: The live Brazil locations page captured on 22 October 2026 still lists RJ01 with the same operating description; the old facility URL now redirects to the relaunched odatadc.com locations page. The Aligned press-release sitemap (to 22 October 2026: latest Brazil item the 17 September DeltaFlow release, which concerns SP04 only) and the ODATA post sitemap report no sale, closure, pause or new RJ01 phase. No later status was found, so operation is kept as of 25 September 2026: 28 days before a 23 October update and inside the 90-day window until 24 December 2026.

status_updates.identity_review: The report concerns consent SSD-63741210, NEXTDC Limited's S4 data centre at Lot 305 DP 1275011, 16 Johnston Crescent, Horsley Park, the same consent, applicant and lot that bind the existing curated NEXTDC S4 project and its reviewed campus locator. It is the existing project's construction, not the separate S4 Phase 2 application (SSD-108864209, Lot 306 DP1275011), which stays held; no new project or site is created and the locator is unchanged.

status.summary: The NSW Department's modification assessment report for NEXTDC S4 Data Centre Horsley Park (SSD-63741210-Mod-2), signed and adopted on 23 September 2026, states that at the time of writing construction of the approved development had commenced. This refreshes the existing in-progress construction record from 30 June to 23 September 2026. It does not identify which of the two approved buildings is under way and does not establish completion, the full 294 MW campus or operation.

status_updates.successor_review: Strictly newer than the existing 30 June 2026 observation (NEXTDC FY26 results). The S4 project record and its post-approval folders captured 22 October 2026 hold no document dated after July 2026 (no completion, occupation or operation notice); the modification determination of 23 September 2026 is the latest record. No later completion, opening, pause or cancellation was found, so under construction is kept as of 23 September 2026.
